// ram_ahb test vectors, one line per clock cycle
// format: HSEL HTRANS HWRITE HSIZE HREADY HADDR HWDATA check exp_HRDATA wait_type
//   HSEL, HWRITE, HREADY, check: bin; HTRANS: 2-bit bin; HSIZE: 3-bit bin; HADDR, HWDATA, exp_HRDATA: hex
//   Each line carries the address phase of one transfer and the HWDATA of the previous transfer's
//   data phase. After the rising edge the testbench compares HRDATA (when check = 1) with the raw
//   word of the last accepted read; HREADYOUT = 1 and HRESP = 0 are checked on every line.
// word writes to three words (address phase; HWDATA belongs to the previous transfer)
1 10 1 010 1 20000000 00000000 0 00000000 1
1 10 1 010 1 20000004 11223344 0 00000000 1
1 10 1 010 1 20000008 55667788 0 00000000 1
0 00 0 010 1 00000000 99AABBCC 0 00000000 1
// read back
1 10 0 010 1 20000000 00000000 1 11223344 1
1 10 0 010 1 20000004 00000000 1 55667788 1
1 10 0 010 1 20000008 00000000 1 99AABBCC 1
0 00 0 010 1 00000000 00000000 1 99AABBCC 1
// byte writes at every offset; untouched lanes keep their contents
1 10 1 000 1 20000000 00000000 1 99AABBCC 1
// store immediately followed by a load of the same word: bypass
1 10 0 010 1 20000000 000000A0 1 112233A0 1
1 10 1 000 1 20000001 00000000 1 112233A0 1
1 10 0 010 1 20000000 0000B100 1 1122B1A0 1
1 10 1 000 1 20000002 00000000 1 1122B1A0 1
1 10 0 010 1 20000000 00C20000 1 11C2B1A0 1
1 10 1 000 1 20000007 00000000 1 11C2B1A0 1
1 10 0 010 1 20000004 D3000000 1 D3667788 1
// halfword writes at both offsets
1 10 1 001 1 2000000A 00000000 1 D3667788 1
1 10 0 010 1 20000008 BEEF0000 1 BEEFBBCC 1
1 10 1 001 1 20000004 00000000 1 BEEFBBCC 1
1 10 0 010 1 20000004 0000CAFE 1 D366CAFE 1
// back-to-back writes to the same word, then a word read
1 10 1 010 1 20000010 00000000 1 D366CAFE 1
1 10 1 000 1 20000013 01020304 1 D366CAFE 1
1 10 0 010 1 20000010 7F7F7F7F 1 7F020304 1
0 00 0 010 1 00000000 00000000 1 7F020304 1
// address phase with HREADY = 0 is not accepted: no write, HRDATA holds
1 10 1 010 0 20000020 00000000 1 7F020304 1
1 10 1 010 0 20000020 0BADF00D 1 7F020304 1
1 10 0 010 0 20000000 00000000 1 7F020304 1
1 10 0 010 1 20000020 00000000 1 00000000 1
// HSEL = 0 or an IDLE transfer: ignored
0 10 1 010 1 20000024 00000000 1 00000000 1
1 00 1 010 1 20000024 0BADF00D 1 00000000 1
1 10 0 010 1 20000024 0BADF00D 1 00000000 1
// SEQ transfer is accepted
1 11 1 010 1 20000028 00000000 1 00000000 1
1 11 0 010 1 20000028 A5A5A5A5 1 A5A5A5A5 1
// highest word and index wrap on bits [15:2]
1 10 0 010 1 2000FFFC 00000000 1 00000000 1
1 10 1 010 1 2000FFFC 00000000 1 00000000 1
1 10 0 010 1 2001FFFC 600DCAFE 1 600DCAFE 1
// random mix of sizes, offsets and back-to-back store/load pairs
0 00 0 010 1 00000000 00000000 1 600DCAFE 1
1 10 1 000 1 20000109 EA7B5BF5 1 600DCAFE 1
1 10 1 010 1 20000100 E8A8529F 1 600DCAFE 1
1 10 1 001 1 20000104 FEE29476 1 600DCAFE 1
1 10 1 010 1 2000010C A399F82A 1 600DCAFE 1
1 10 1 000 1 2000010D BDC2AE99 1 600DCAFE 1

1 10 1 001 1 2000010E F6CED90A 1 BDC2DA99 1
1 10 1 001 1 20000100 22CEDAFB 1 BDC2DA99 1
